name: useSatelliteNTN
summary: 3GPP Release-17 Non-Terrestrial Network (satellite SOS) status and alignment telemetry.
plain: Tracks direct-to-satellite modem connectivity for emergency SOS, reporting provider connection states, signal strength bars, and horizon antenna pointing guidance.
description: Interfaces with Android 15+ (API 35+) satellite telephony services and 3GPP Rel-17 NTN modems. Monitors real-time satellite connection states (disconnected, searching, connected, pointing_assist), provider network names, signal quality bars (0 to 4), emergency SOS packet readiness, and surfaces azimuth and elevation vectors to assist pointing the phone at the horizon satellite constellation.

returns.name: isSupported
returns.desc: Whether this device hardware and modem support Non-Terrestrial Network satellite links.

returns.name: connectionState
returns.desc: Current lifecycle connection state with the satellite constellation.

returns.name: carrier
returns.desc: Satellite network provider name (e.g. Skylo, T-Mobile Starlink, Iridium), or null.

returns.name: signalQualityBars
returns.desc: Signal quality indicator bars (0 to 4), or null if disconnected.

returns.name: pointingGuidance
returns.desc: Antenna pointing guidance with azimuth, elevation, and alignment flag, or null.

returns.name: emergencyServicesReady
returns.desc: Whether the satellite link is ready for emergency SOS packet transmission.

returns.name: error
returns.desc: Error message if satellite modem querying failed.

returns.name: refresh
returns.desc: Re-reads satellite modem connectivity and pointing status.

actions.name: refresh()
actions.desc: Queries the satellite subsystem for updated connectivity and antenna guidance.

agentNote: Requires Android 15+ (API 35+) and device hardware equipped with a 3GPP Rel-17 NTN satellite modem (Google Pixel 9 and later).
